persistence_invariants.brief: A composite unique constraint on (sku, location) guarantees each SKU at each location is uniquely addressable; a write collision is resolved at write time, never two stored duplicates (R3).
A CHECK constraint enforces quantity >= 0 so stock never goes below zero; a pick that would overcommit is rejected at write time, never a stored negative (R2).
sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code are NOT NULL so a durably-saved stock record always captures the full identifying tuple (AC1).
Each inventory adjustment persists an unmodifiable created_at timestamp and actor (both NOT NULL) that survive schema migrations (R1).
Every additive schema migration is reversible and preserves inventory records created before it, so existing stock data survives migration with no loss (R1).

nfrs.brief: Existing stock data survives every additive schema migration with no loss; each adjustment keeps an unmodifiable timestamp and actor. Defended by a real-branch migration-reversibility fitness test (PI4, PI5).
Stock levels never go below zero and never overcommit beyond available quantity; an overcommitting pick is rejected at write time by a DB CHECK constraint plus service-layer guard (PI2).
Every (sku, location) pair is uniquely addressable; a collision is resolved at write time via the composite unique constraint, never two stored duplicates nor an error page (PI1).

Integration tests run against the paired Lakebase branch (databricks_postgres via DATABASE_URL), never a mock/stub/in-memory substitute; CI refuses to merge a PR whose integration tests do not run against a real branch.

The UI is a React + TypeScript SPA under client/ that loads once and navigates client-side with optimistic in-place row updates; the boundary layer returns JSON only (no server-rendered HTML), so boundary renders_via is react.
Validation errors name the offending field rather than a generic 'bad request'; owned at the API boundary (Preferences).
A stock row missing optional detail (par level, batch, serial) renders cleanly with an explicit 'not tracked', never a null crash or blank region (Preferences).
